title: Fix File not found, cause 1: package not installed

scenes.narration: Cause one: the package is not installed.
scenes.caption: The package is not installed.

scenes.narration: Small distributions such as TinyTeX and BasicTeX ship only some packages. The log names the file it wanted, cleveref dot S T Y.
scenes.caption: cleveref.sty is not on this machine.

scenes.narration: Install it with tlmgr, the TeX Live package manager, and build again.
scenes.caption: tlmgr install cleveref

lines: ModernTex flags this as you type. purplelink.llc/moderntex
